verdict.rationale: Square documents an official MCP server on its developer site ("Square Model Context Protocol Server"), and a probe confirmed the page at developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp, so the core story is delivered first-party. The evidence consists only of the page title and the probe's existence check. Missing for 10: details on exposed tools/API coverage, authentication and connection setup, hosted vs. local deployment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.
